summary: Iteration 9 backend testing for the ARPABET-respelling fix to /api/tts. Verified the SSML-silent regression is gone: 'direction' and 8 other CMU-known words now return >12KB decoded MP3s (real audio). CMU-unknown words fall through gracefully with >4KB audio. Cache regression works. Full backend test suite (96 tests) passes.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 948 lines — approaching the 700-line split threshold; consider modularizing TTS/phonetics/dialogue routes.

The other backend test files (test_accent_coach.py, test_caption_search.py, test_dialogue_only.py, test_pronounce.py, test_proper_nouns_and_tts_turn.py) don't call load_dotenv() like test_tts_pronunciation.py does — they crash at collection time unless REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is exported. Minor DRY/setup consistency issue; adding a conftest.py that loads /app/frontend/.env would fix all of them.
arpabet_to_respelling: schwa (AH0) is currently rendered 'uh' (same as stressed AH). Fine for TTS but consider a distinct schwa symbol if fine-tuning is needed later.
seed_data_creation: None. audio_cache in test_database is warmed with the tested words after this run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New file /app/backend/tests/test_tts_respelling.py covers the iteration-9 respelling fix with 16 tests: unit tests for phonetics.arpabet_to_respelling, primary >12KB size assertion for 9 CMU-known words, >4KB fallback for CMU-unknown words, and cache regression. Run with: `export $(grep -v ^# /app/frontend/.env | xargs) && MONGO_URL='mongodb://localhost:27017' DB_NAME='test_database' pytest /app/backend/tests/ --tb=short`. Older sibling test files (test_accent_coach.py etc.) rely on REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL being in the process env — they don't load .env themselves.
rca of the issue: Iteration 8's SSML <phoneme alphabet='ipa' ph='...'> approach was silently broken because ElevenLabs' eleven_multilingual_v2 model does not parse SSML phoneme tags — it emitted 6-7KB truncated/silent MP3s. Iteration 9 replaces SSML with a plain-text ARPABET respelling (e.g. 'der-EHKSH-uhn' for 'direction') that multilingual_v2 reads phonetically, producing full-length (>12KB) audio. Verified by decoding audio_b64 and asserting byte length.
